📚 1. 15 Từ Vựng Cốt Lõi (Kèm Phát Âm Audio Bản Xứ)

⚠️ BẠN ĐANG MỞ Ở CHẾ ĐỘ XEM TRƯỚC — ÂM THANH SẼ KHÔNG CHẠY
Ứng dụng Tệp (Files) và Zalo trên iPhone chặn JavaScript, nên nút 🔊, chấm điểm và micro đều bị vô hiệu.
👉 Hãy mở bài học bằng đường link https:// mà giáo viên gửi (bấm vào link trong Zalo ➔ chọn biểu tượng la bàn Safari).
Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. aesthetic (adj/n)
/iːsˈθetɪk/
thuộc về thẩm mỹ, cái đẹp nghệ thuật; n (aesthetics): mỹ học, vẻ đẹp thẩm mỹ
Collocation: aesthetic value, aesthetic appeal, enhance the aesthetic quality
"Public sculptures and green parks greatly enhance the aesthetic appeal of modern cities."
2. masterpiece (n)
/ˈmɑːstəpiːs/
kiệt tác, tác phẩm nghệ thuật/văn học xuất sắc nhất
Collocation: artistic masterpiece, literary masterpiece, create a masterpiece
"Thousands of tourists visit the Louvre every day to admire Leonardo da Vinci's masterpiece."
3. literature (n)
/ˈlɪtrətʃə(r)/
văn học, tác phẩm văn chương (adj: literary — thuộc văn học)
Collocation: classical literature, contemporary literature, study literature
"Reading classical literature cultivates empathy and deepens our understanding of human history."
4. sculpture (n)
/ˈskʌlptʃə(r)/
nghệ thuật điêu khắc; bức tượng điêu khắc
Collocation: bronze sculpture, marble sculpture, outdoor sculpture exhibition
"The city council commissioned a local artist to create a bronze sculpture for the town square."
5. gallery (n)
/ˈɡæləri/
phòng trưng bày, bảo tàng triển lãm nghệ thuật (art gallery)
Collocation: national art gallery, contemporary gallery, visit a gallery
"Free admission to national museums and art galleries makes culture accessible to all citizens."
6. creativity (n)
/ˌkriːeɪˈtɪvəti/
sự sáng tạo, tư duy sáng tạo (v: create, adj: creative)
Collocation: foster creativity, stimulate creativity, artistic creativity
"Music and painting classes at school foster creativity and emotional intelligence in children."
7. inspire (v)
/ɪnˈspaɪə(r)/
truyền cảm hứng, khơi nguồn sáng tạo (n: inspiration, adj: inspiring)
Collocation: inspire young generations, be inspired by nature
"Folk melodies and traditional legends continue to inspire contemporary Vietnamese musicians."
8. enrich (v)
/ɪnˈrɪtʃ/
làm phong phú, làm giàu thêm (đời sống tinh thần, tâm hồn, vốn văn hóa)
Collocation: enrich spiritual life, enrich cultural understanding, enrich the mind
"Attending live theatre performances and concerts can enrich our spiritual and emotional lives."
9. identity (n)
/aɪˈdentəti/
bản sắc (văn hóa, dân tộc)
Collocation: preserve cultural identity, national identity, sense of identity
"Traditional folk music and folk art are vital for preserving a nation's cultural identity."
10. portray (v)
/pɔːˈtreɪ/
khắc họa, miêu tả, phản ánh (trong tranh vẽ, phim ảnh, tiểu thuyết)
Collocation: vividly portray, portray daily life, portray historical events
"The novel vividly portrays the struggles and resilience of working-class families in the 19th century."
11. genre (n)
/ˈʒɒnrə/
thể loại (âm nhạc, văn học, điện ảnh)
Collocation: musical genre, literary genre, science-fiction genre
"While older generations enjoy classical and folk music, teenagers prefer modern pop genres."
12. patronage (n)
/ˈpætrənɪdʒ/
sự bảo trợ, sự tài trợ cho nghệ thuật (từ chính phủ hoặc nhà hảo tâm)
Collocation: state patronage, corporate patronage of the arts
"Without state patronage and public grants, many independent theatres would go bankrupt."
13. tangible (adj)
/ˈtændʒəbl/
hữu hình, có thể cầm nắm/nhìn thấy rõ (trái nghĩa: intangible — phi vật thể, vô hình)
Collocation: tangible economic benefits, intangible cultural heritage
"Critics argue that hospitals and roads bring more tangible benefits to taxpayers than abstract art."
14. censor (v/n)
/ˈsensə(r)/
kiểm duyệt, cắt bỏ nội dung nhạy cảm (n: censorship — sự kiểm duyệt)
Collocation: censor violent content, strict artistic censorship
"Debates often arise over whether authorities should censor controversial films and artworks."
15. allocate (v)
/ˈæləkeɪt/
phân bổ, cấp phát (ngân sách, nguồn lực — allocate A to B)
Collocation: allocate public funds to, allocate a portion of the budget
"Governments should allocate a reasonable portion of the national budget to cultural preservation."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Mệnh Đề Nhượng Bộ 'Although / Even Though' vs. Cụm Giới Từ 'Despite / In Spite Of'

• 1. Although / Even though / Though + S + V (Mệnh đề đầy đủ):
  Ví dụ: Although public services such as healthcare and education require massive funding, governments should not neglect the arts.
  Lưu ý tuyệt đối: Đã có Although ở đầu câu thì KHÔNG ĐƯỢC dùng but ở vế sau!

• 2. Despite / In spite of + Cụm danh từ (Noun Phrase) / V-ing:
  Ví dụ: Despite the high cost of maintaining national galleries, admission should remain free.
  Ví dụ: In spite of not generating immediate profit, classical literature enriches our cultural identity.

• 3. Mẹo biến Despite đi được với Mệnh đề (S + V): Thêm the fact that ngay sau Despite / In spite of:
  Ví dụ: Despite the fact that abstract art is difficult to understand, it stimulates creative thinking.

🔵 Tầng 2: Cấu Trúc Nhượng Bộ Nâng Cao 'While It Is True That..., I Believe That...' (C1 Task 2)

• Công thức mở đoạn Thân bài 2 (Phản biện sắc bén chuẩn Band 7.5+):
  While it is undeniable / true that [Lập luận của đối phương], I firmly believe that [Lập luận của bạn].
  Ví dụ: While it is undeniable that hospitals and highways bring more tangible benefits to citizens, I firmly believe that allocating a modest budget to the arts is essential for preserving national identity.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. Planting trees and installing modern sculptures significantly improve the ________ appeal of urban plazas.
2. 'The Tale of Kieu' by Nguyen Du is universally regarded as a ________ of Vietnamese poetry.
3. Studying classical ________ at school helps students develop strong reading comprehension and empathy.
4. A giant marble ________ of the national hero stands at the entrance of the central park.
5. Local painters are displaying their latest oil paintings at the contemporary art ________ downtown.
6. Encouraging children to learn a musical instrument or paint helps foster their imagination and ________.
7. Stunning mountain landscapes have continued to ________ poets and landscape painters for centuries.
8. Reading diverse books and attending cultural festivals ________ our minds and broaden our horizons.
9. Protecting traditional folk music and historical monuments is crucial for maintaining our cultural ________.
10. Historical films often ________ the courage and sacrifices of ordinary citizens during wartime.
11. Jazz, hip-hop, and classical symphony are three completely different musical ________.
12. During the Renaissance, wealthy families provided financial ________ to support painters and architects.
13. Building new hospitals and railways brings immediate, ________ benefits that taxpayers can clearly see.
14. Film boards often ________ movies that contain extreme violence or hate speech to protect children.
15. Critics argue that the government should ________ more tax revenue to healthcare rather than opera houses.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 21] By 2050, the elderly segment is projected to make up roughly a ________ (25%) of the population.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 20] Agriculture dominated water usage in four nations, with the ________ exception of Germany.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 19] Injured wild animals are cared for in a protected forest ________ before being released.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 17] At the final stage, clean electricity is transmitted to the national power ________.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 15] Installing surveillance cameras in museums acts as a strong ________ against art theft.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. ________ public healthcare and education require vast funding, governments should still allocate a small budget to the arts.
2. ________ the high maintenance costs of national museums, admission remains free for all students.
3. Many independent theatre actors love their profession in spite of ________ a relatively modest income.
4. Despite ________ digital books are convenient, many readers still prefer the smell and feel of printed literature.
5. Spot the Vietlish trap: Although the sculpture was controversial, ________ it attracted thousands of tourists to the square.
6. A small portion of tax revenue ought to ________ to preserve traditional folk music and historic theatres.
7. ________ classical literature at school helps young people understand complex human emotions.
8. Cultural festivals not only enrich spiritual life, ________ they also generate substantial tourism revenue.
9. The National Art Gallery, ________ houses over two thousand priceless masterpieces, was renovated last year.
10. By 2040, the number of virtual museum visitors is projected ________ the number of physical visitors.

👩 Gallery Curator: We would love to welcome your students, Thomas! Could you spell your surname for our school booking list?
👨 Art Teacher: Certainly, it is Sterling. S - T - E - R - L - I - N - G. 💡 Đáp án câu 1 (Họ giáo viên): STERLING
👩 Gallery Curator: Thank you. Our new exhibition features fifty masterpieces created by local artists to portray our city's cultural identity.

👨 Art Teacher: That will really inspire my students' creativity! Do you offer a practical workshop after the gallery tour?
👩 Gallery Curator: Yes, we run a 90-minute clay modelling workshop in the studio upstairs. 💡 Đáp án câu 3 (Thời lượng workshop): 90 / ninety
👨 Art Teacher: How much does the gallery tour and clay workshop cost per student?

👨 Art Teacher: Four pounds fifty is wonderful! Can my students submit their own paintings to your annual competition?
👩 Gallery Curator: Absolutely! The theme for this year's competition is Urban Nature, and the winner receives an art grant of 500 pounds. 💡 Đáp án câu 5 (Chủ đề cuộc thi): Urban Nature
👨 Art Teacher: When is the final deadline for students to submit their artwork?
👩 Gallery Curator: All entries must be delivered to the gallery reception desk by the 18th of October. Good luck to your students! 💡 Đáp án câu 6 (Hạn chót nộp bài): 18th October / October 18

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - The Argument for Prioritizing Tangible Public Services]
Every year, governments face difficult decisions regarding how to allocate limited tax revenues. Critics of state patronage for the arts argue that public money should be spent exclusively on essential services that bring immediate, tangible benefits to citizens, such as hospitals, schools, and transport infrastructure. From this perspective, spending millions of dollars on opera houses, abstract sculptures, or contemporary art galleries is an unnecessary luxury when healthcare systems are overburdened.

[Paragraph B - The Spiritual and Cultural Value of Arts and Literature]
Despite these practical concerns, defenders of cultural funding maintain that a society cannot thrive on material wealth alone. Classical literature, visual arts, and diverse musical genres play an irreplaceable role in enriching our spiritual lives and fostering human creativity. Artistic masterpieces vividly portray a nation's history and struggles, preserving its unique cultural identity for future generations. Without public subsidies, traditional folk theatres and museums would close, leaving culture accessible only to the wealthy.

[Paragraph C - Economic Returns and Creative Freedom]
Furthermore, investing in the arts generates substantial economic returns. Vibrant museums, outdoor aesthetic landmarks, and music festivals inspire cultural tourism, creating thousands of jobs in hospitality and retail. Provided that governments allocate a balanced budget without attempting to strictly censor artistic expression, supporting both public infrastructure and the arts ensures a healthy, prosperous, and civilized nation.
Điểm: 0/6

✍️ Academic Writing Lab (Task 2 Discussion): Tài Trợ Ngân Sách Cho Nghệ Thuật (Arts & Museums) vs. Dịch Vụ Thiết Yếu (Hospitals & Schools)

Đề bài: Some people think that government money should be spent on public services like healthcare and education rather than on the arts (such as music, painting, and museums). To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write a paragraph or short essay (95 - 125 words).
